purpose: Guidance only. Farmers should verify the applicable season, crop, area notification, deadlines, documents, and authorized reporting channel for their location.
steps: Enter crop, location, season, cultivated area, and sowing information.
Check the current official crop-insurance notification applicable to the farmer's area and season.
Use an authorized enrollment or service channel for insurance registration.
If crop damage occurs, record photographs, date, location, crop, affected area, and damage details as early as possible.
Submit loss information through the authorized government or insurance process within the applicable reporting window.
Keep the application or loss reference number and track its status through the authorized channel.
evidence: Farmer photograph or photographs of the affected crop/material
Crop and variety information when available
Date and approximate time of damage
Description of the event such as heavy rain, flood, cyclone, drought, hailstorm, pest, or other notified risk
Available application, policy, or reference number
disclaimer: AgriAI does not determine final insurance eligibility, assess losses, approve claims, or determine compensation. Those decisions remain with authorized government and insurance authorities.
